summarize_model_config: summarize the ResNet-34 CIFAR model configuration dictionary with backbone, neck, and head settings
review_model_config: review the ImageClassifier model config using ResNet_CIFAR depth 34 backbone for CIFAR-10 classification
build_model_from_config: build an ImageClassifier model from the ResNet-34 CIFAR config with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead
refactor_model_config: refactor the ResNet-34 CIFAR model config to change num_classes or backbone depth
test_model_config: test the ResNet-34 CIFAR model config by instantiating the ImageClassifier with the provided dictionary
